claims.text: Hyaluronidase into the foreskin: 1 mL (150 U) total in 1 or 2 SC injections (avoid intravascular injection: anaphylaxis); disperses the edema rapidly.
claims.quote: Hyaluronidase injections into the foreskin: Inject 1 mL (150 U) total in 1 or 2 subcutaneous injections using a tuberculin syringe (avoid intravascular injection, which can cause anaphylaxis). The hyaluronidase causes rapid dispersal of edema into surrounding tissues.

claims.text: Osmotic agents (sugar, salt) on the glans and foreskin draw out edema; may take hours and should not be used in acute paraphimosis.
claims.quote: Application of osmotic agents to the foreskin: Sugar and salt are hypertonic agents, which will draw out the hypotonic edema when applied to the glans and foreskin. This process may take hours and should not be used in acute paraphimosis

claims.text: Children may need local anesthesia and sometimes sedation.
claims.quote: Children and even anxious adults may require local anesthesia and sometimes sedation to undergo treatment.
